label: kizuna_language_b_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I’m in a bit of a\npinch![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_03
text: This Pawmi really doesn’t seem to be feeling well!\nI don’t know if the poor thing can even stand up!\r\nWhat should I do? What should I do?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_04
text: Oh, right! I could use a Potion! Do you have any\non you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_05
text:
You don’t?! Ahhh! What should I do? What
should I do?!\c
Waouh! Hold on—I had exactly one Potion in
my pocket![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_06
text: This’ll fix you right up, my friend! Potion\npower, GO![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_07
text: Phew. That seems to have done the trick just in\nthe nick of time![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_08
text: But this Pawmi doesn’t appear to belong to a\nTrainer. Hmm... Could a wild Pokémon have\r\nwandered onto the academy grounds?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_09
text: Still, I can’t just leave it here alone without\nanyone to make sure it’s OK.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_10
text: It’s decided, then! I, Salvatore, will just have to\nlend all of the helping hands I have to take care\r\nof Pawmi in this touch-and-go situation![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Mr. Salvatore!
